item.title: Rapidfire 1.0.4
item.description:
• Before opening a large palette at once, Rapidfire now asks in place of the list: “Open 11 from Morning?”, with Open All, Cancel and Back. The overlay widens to fit the question. Before, the question was a line in the header that a narrow overlay cut off, and the overlay waited for Return without showing why.
  • A link that runs a palette asks the same question when the palette is large, instead of only showing the palette.
  • With Control held, the header no longer cuts off “Opens the whole palette” or squeezes the hand switcher in a narrow overlay.
  • Large libraries are much faster. Show All on 2,240 triggers in 320 palettes took over a minute and now opens in about half a second; with Shrink text to fit, from minutes to about a second. A palette of 300 triggers opens about three times faster.
  • Show All can show just the shape of a library: Settings › Overlay › Show All › Show › Folders Only shows only the folders inside opened folders, each with how many triggers it holds.
  • The light beside the pin is easier to see in light mode.
  • “Delete” is used for the key that steps back, as on the Mac’s keyboard.

item.title: Rapidfire 1.0.3
item.description: • A pinned overlay now follows a dynamic palette: when the palette is switched, the overlay shows the new triggers at once. Before, it kept the old ones until something else changed.

item.title: Rapidfire 1.0.2
item.description: • Opened by a click on the menu bar icon, the overlay no longer shows a blue focus ring around the pin (seen on macOS 15).

item.title: Rapidfire 1.0.1
item.description:
The pinned overlay can be moved

  • Watching now has a pin in place of the eye. Press ⌘K or click the pin to keep the overlay open.
  • A pinned overlay can be dragged by its top row or by the margin around the list, for example beside the window of an AI assistant. It grows from its top left corner as triggers are added. Closing it unpins it, and the next overlay opens in its usual place.
  • A small light beside the pin is on while an AI assistant uses Rapidfire through MCP.
  • With VoiceOver, the pin's actions move the overlay to a corner of the screen.
